```python
# filename: normalize_and_match.py
from typing import List

# Input lists from prior extraction
DEHYDRATED = [
    'apples (dehydrated)', 'apricots (dehydrated)', 'peaches (dehydrated)', 'pears (dehydrated)',
    'prunes (dehydrated)', 'onions (dehydrated)', 'potatoes (dehydrated)', 'carrots (dehydrated)',
    'peas (dehydrated)', 'spinach (dehydrated)', 'sweet corn (dehydrated)'
]

FROZEN_CHILLED = [
    'Frozen Apples', 'Frozen Apricots', 'Frozen Peaches', 'Frozen Pears', 'Frozen Prunes',
    'Frozen Onions', 'Frozen Potatoes', 'Frozen Carrots', 'Frozen Peas', 'Frozen Spinach',
    'Frozen Sweet Corn', 'Frozen Tomatoes', 'Chilled Lettuce', 'Chilled Celery'
]

# Normalize dehydrated names
def canonicalize_dehydrated(items: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    out = []
    for x in items:
        base = x.lower().replace('(dehydrated)', '').strip()
        out.append(base)
    return out

# Normalize frozen names
def canonicalize_frozen(items: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    out = []
    for x in items:
        xl = x.lower()
        if xl.startswith('chilled '):
            continue  # exclude chilled
        if xl.startswith('frozen '):
            out.append(xl.replace('frozen ', '').strip())
    return out

D_CAN = canonicalize_dehydrated(DEHYDRATED)
F_CAN = canonicalize_frozen(FROZEN_CHILLED)

# Include frozen items only if they contain the whole name of a dehydrated item
MATCHED_FROZEN = [f for f in F_CAN if f in D_CAN]

COMBINED = [f"{d} (dehydrated)" for d in D_CAN] + [f"{f} (frozen)" for f in MATCHED_FROZEN]

print("Canonical dehydrated:", D_CAN)
print("Canonical frozen candidates:", F_CAN)
print("Matched frozen:", MATCHED_FROZEN)
print("Combined relevant items:", COMBINED)
print("Total relevant count:", len(COMBINED))
```
